tokens.name: night
tokens.usage: The stage behind every screen and the headers. Never a paper color.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Iron-gall ink: text on parchment, parchment-deep and cream; dark wells, inactive step tabs, hard rules. 14.6:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: mahogany
tokens.usage: The desk wood's own color under its texture, the notebook binder and the login card.

tokens.name: sepia
tokens.usage: Hairlines, underlines, pip rings and secondary text on parchment (7.9:1). Secondary text on paper is full sepia, never faded ink.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: The base of every paper object: creator sheet, book pages, slips, pamphlets, dispatch letter, memo pad.

tokens.name: parchment-deep
tokens.usage: Inset wells, older paper (the Herald, field sketches), inactive tabs; also text on night (12.7:1).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: The brightest paper (dossier, notebook pages, cards); text and labels on night, mahogany and oxblood.

tokens.name: oxblood
tokens.usage: The one action ink. Primary buttons, active tabs and slips, filled marks and pips, section headings on paper, focus underline on ledger fields, selection, errors on paper. Cream text on it. Never small text on night.

tokens.name: oxblood-lit
tokens.usage: Oxblood lifted to read on dark grounds: 5.8:1 on night, 5.1:1 on gm-night. Text and thin rules on dark only, never a fill.

tokens.name: candle-gold
tokens.usage: Gilded dice and pips, the selected ability, drive or question, brass details, Illumination milestone rings, the focus ring. Never text on paper (1.6:1 on parchment: fails, by design it never sits there).

tokens.name: gold-leaf
tokens.usage: The chapter hub tomes' embossed lettering and frames, and the padlock. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: register-green
tokens.usage: The leather of the Case Ledger tome on the chapter hub.

tokens.name: seal-green
tokens.usage: Confirmed and successful states on paper: Report filed, 3/3 placed, Confirmed, roll entries in the log. 6.0:1 on parchment.

tokens.name: seal-green-lit
tokens.usage: The seal on dark grounds: status dots on tomes, dice that count on the felt, confirmed relationships, sent invites.

tokens.name: gm-night
tokens.usage: The Lightkeeper desk's ground and header, the sticky tab strip and the map frame.

tokens.name: gm-slate
tokens.usage: The Lightkeeper's Desk bar and its buttons.

tokens.name: moonlight-steel
tokens.usage: Lightkeeper section labels, icons, rules, pagers and ghost buttons on gm-night (7.4:1) and gm-slate (5.0:1).

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The ground of the current desk: night on the player side and the hub, gm-night on the Lightkeeper's screens.

tokens.name: stage-raised
tokens.usage: Bars and wood on the current desk: mahogany for the player, gm-slate for the Lightkeeper's Desk bar.

tokens.name: stage-chrome
tokens.usage: Labels, icons and ghost buttons drawn straight on stage and stage-raised. Paper objects never take it.

tokens.name: stage-alert
tokens.usage: Errors, the death notice and the Retire hover on stage (5.8:1 on night, 5.1:1 on gm-night).

tokens.name: role-face
tokens.usage: Face role: card frames and selection state in the creator's deck. Mix 60/40 with cream (roleInk) for text on night.

tokens.name: role-muscle
tokens.usage: Muscle role: card frames and selection state. Mix 60/40 with cream for text on night.

tokens.name: role-scholar
tokens.usage: Scholar role: card frames and selection state. Mix 60/40 with cream for text on night.

tokens.name: role-slink
tokens.usage: Slink role: card frames and selection state. Mix 60/40 with cream for text on night.

tokens.name: role-weird
tokens.usage: Weird role: card frames and selection state. Mix 60/40 with cream for text on night.

tokens.name: drive-nerve
tokens.usage: Nerve drive column: a 7% wash, a 30% double rule, the drive name and its filled drive squares.

tokens.name: drive-cunning
tokens.usage: Cunning drive column: wash, rule, name and filled squares.

tokens.name: drive-intuition
tokens.usage: Intuition drive column: wash, rule, name and filled squares.

tokens.name: material-felt
tokens.usage: Material only: the dice tray's green felt. Never interface chrome.

tokens.name: material-tray-wood
tokens.usage: Material only: the dice tray's wood rim and the Lightkeeper's control rail on it.

tokens.name: material-desk-wood
tokens.usage: Material only: the hub's drawn desk wood under its grain, kept dark and in shadow.

tokens.name: material-desk-leather
tokens.usage: Material only: the hub's oxblood leather writing inset.

tokens.name: material-plum-leather
tokens.usage: Material only: the Last Played tome's leather.

tokens.name: material-ticket-sage
tokens.usage: Material only: the company band on the player's railway ticket.

tokens.name: material-wax-light
tokens.usage: Material only: the wax seal's lit red (top left of its gradient).

tokens.name: material-wax
tokens.usage: Material only: the wax seal's middle red.

tokens.name: material-wax-dark
tokens.usage: Material only: the wax seal's darkest red (lower right).

tokens.name: material-wax-rim
tokens.usage: Material only: the wax seal's 1px rim.

tokens.name: material-wax-mark
tokens.usage: Material only: the candle-holder mark pressed into the seal.

tokens.name: material-gilt-light
tokens.usage: Material only: the gilded die's gold leaf, lit corner.

tokens.name: material-gilt-dark
tokens.usage: Material only: the gilded die's gold leaf, shaded corner.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The wordmark on hub, creator, player and Lightkeeper headers; uppercase; 28px on phones.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Step titles, Join a Campaign, the roster book's page titles, the death notice. Uppercase; 30 to 36px; oxblood on paper, cream on night.

styles.name: headline-sm
styles.usage: Tome titles, ticket titles, dispatch letterhead, the roll's outcome stamp.

styles.name: hand
styles.usage: The notebook's own headings only (Field Notes, Log a Field Entry, Private Field Notes). Mixed case, 30 to 48px. Never a label or a sentence.

styles.name: title
styles.sample: A — Raise One Starting-Zero Action to 1
styles.usage: Ability and character names, sub-section heads, field questions (Catalyst, Curiosity). 18 to 24px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: When you take an action, roll a number of dice equal to its rating and keep the highest.
styles.usage: Rule text, descriptions, the dispatch letter, roster names, form values.

styles.name: body-italic
styles.usage: Game state and short letterhead lines, in sentence case.

styles.name: ledger-value
styles.usage: Values typed on a ledger field's line.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, tabs, field labels, status chips. Uppercase, 700 to 900, 12 to 14px. Short words only.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: The creator's Advance and Back buttons and the step bar from lg.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Numbers and identifiers only: counts, dice totals, timers, campaign codes, usernames, dates. Use tabular-nums. 12 to 16px.

styles.name: print-form-line
styles.usage: A form's printed number, uppercase, sepia at 62%. Decoration under the twelve pixel floor; aria-hidden.

styles.name: print-edge
styles.sample: CANDELA ARCHIVE · FORM C.O. 7 · CANDELA ARCHIVE
styles.usage: Small print along a sheet's bottom edge, sepia at 42%, clipped by the paper.

styles.name: print-serial
styles.usage: A numbering machine's red figures in a sheet's corner: oxblood at 68%, tabular.

styles.name: print-stamp
styles.usage: A rubber date stamp's word, uppercase, in a 1.5px currentColor frame at 72% opacity.

styles.name: pen
styles.sample: The lamp went out at the third bell.
styles.usage: Only text a person wrote: notebook entries, signatures, business-card names, in the player's chosen pen and ink. Caveat is the default of 20 pens.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between pips, chips and drive squares.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap inside a row of controls (gap-2); vertical button padding.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between grouped fields (gap-3, p-3); chip and well padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Well and card padding (p-4); column gaps; the desk's edge gutter from xl; phone side margin.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Column gaps in panels (gap-6, px-6); step tab padding.

tokens.name: space-panel
tokens.usage: A full parchment panel's inner padding from sm (p-8).

tokens.name: space-gutter
tokens.usage: The creator's side margins on desktop (px-10).

tokens.name: space-rule
tokens.usage: The pitch of ruled writing lines (paper-ruled): vertical rhythm on paper comes from rules, not gaps.

tokens.name: space-touch
tokens.usage: The minimum touch target on coarse pointers (md:[@media(pointer:coarse)]:min-h-[44px]).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Default: parchment panels, wells, chips, tags, rubber stamps.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, the creator's step bar, dice faces. The ceiling for any rectangle.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only things round in the world: action pips, Illumination dots, wax seals, dials.

shadow.note: One lamp, above left: every cast shadow falls down and right, pure black at high opacity. No glows except the gilded die's halo.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: A parchment panel resting on the night stage.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The creator's PaperSheet and the admission slip: cast shadow plus an aged inner tone.

tokens.name: shadow-object
tokens.usage: Cards, pamphlets, tabs and slips lying on the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-tome
tokens.usage: The deepest objects: tomes on the hub.

tokens.name: shadow-circle-paper
tokens.usage: The circle's papers on the Circle tab.

tokens.name: shadow-well
tokens.usage: Mark boxes and recessed wells on parchment.

tokens.name: shadow-brass
tokens.usage: The brass button at rest; none while pressed.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Dialogs over the desk.

tokens.name: shadow-gilded-halo
tokens.usage: The gilded die's soft halo on the felt. The one glow in the system.

tilt.note: Hand-placed objects lie slightly crooked, at an angle fixed per object by tiltFor(key) in components/shared/handPlaced.js.

tokens.name: tilt-min
tokens.usage: The smallest lean of a hand-placed card, note or slip.

tokens.name: tilt-max
tokens.usage: The largest lean; neighbours in a list alternate direction.

tokens.name: tilt-phone-scale
tokens.usage: Multiplier on --tilt below 640px (.hand-placed).

tokens.name: tilt-stamp
tokens.usage: Default lean of an ink stamp or an empty stamp outline.

tokens.name: tilt-seal
tokens.usage: The wax seal's turn.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Phone landscape and up: the creator sheet shows its form line and serial.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Tablet: the phone drawer gives way to the stacked desk.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Most responsive switching; the hub's free desk needs lg plus landscape.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Desks fit the screen: three columns, the page never scrolls.

tokens.name: bp-2xl
tokens.usage: Larger hourglass on the Lightkeeper desk.
